title: The surviving witnesses
direction: User requested design of the first study before continuing the remaining research dossiers.
concept: An archive inspection desk: distinguish the physical object, its surviving text and the conclusions drawn from it.
implemented: Original schematic manuscript artwork; no simulated facsimiles or invented transcriptions
Six selectable witnesses with object, text and journey lenses
Source links and attributed dating beside every record
104-symbol P46 leaf diagram: 56 Dublin, 30 Michigan, 18 missing from reconstructed total
Custody filters with animated emphasis and stable layout
Three further-reading doors and full source directory
Academic entry card and standard page transitions
scope: A curated introductory study using verified claims from six witnesses. The larger 13-object research dossier retains its outstanding questions; not all entries are represented as finished research.
additionalVerification: Michigan: P46 introduction, present state and discovery history
British Library Royal MS 1 D VIII: dated 400–499, physical gaps, four-volume collection and custody
Cambridge University Library: Bezae record via Google Arts & Culture and 2017 recovery report
IGNTP: P52 transcription repository record; Nongbri 2020 article abstract
Israel Museum: Piecing Together the Past and Rescued from Fire
